title: One customer enquiry, start to finish
body: Follow one implemented workflow: update a customer record in the CRM, verify the change, then send a saved acknowledgement. Shown with sample records and private provider versions.

items.label: Define
items.title: Set the scope for one enquiry
items.body: For Customer C-104, the steps are fixed. A CRM agent is scoped to update that record. An email agent is scoped to send the saved acknowledgement, which waits on the CRM step.

items.label: Approve
items.title: Review each exact action before it runs
items.body: An independent reviewer approves the exact CRM update. The exact acknowledgement gets its own separate approval. If the details change, those approvals no longer cover them.

items.label: Verify
items.title: Read the CRM back before emailing
items.body: After the update, LoopLabs reads the C-104 record back from the CRM. The acknowledgement is sent only after that update is verified and its own approval is in place.

items.label: Reconcile
items.title: Check the provider before any retry
items.body: In the demo, the CRM response was deliberately lost. LoopLabs checked the record first and found the update applied once. Nothing was written or sent twice. If results stay unknown or conflicting, it holds.

diagram.noDuplicate: No second CRM write, no repeated message
diagram.unknownHeld: If still unknown or conflicting, the workflow holds
diagram.sampleNote: Sample records and private provider versions. No real email sent.
